note: Checkpoint D5 FINAL cumulative golden for the COMPOSED solver.html (byte-identical to the pre-D baseline). Its fields fall into THREE provenance classes, spelled out per-field in the provenance block: (1) INDEPENDENT HISTORICAL SOURCE - compared against a pre-D or pre-phase fixture: head/body/engine/style(inner)/ui_script(engine-removed)/external_scripts/css_version (from the pre-D D0 baseline solver-interface-baseline.json); composed_total/inline_script/ui_pre_engine/ui_post_engine/requests/dist_public/controls (from the D1 phase golden, cross-checked composed_total==215539 pre-D bytes); the eight earlier fragment SHAs (from the D1-D4 per-phase goldens); aria.aria_attrs and data_i18n_count (from the D2 and D4 phase goldens). (2) REVIEWED D5 CAPTURE - captured once during D5 from the composed baseline and human-reviewed, NOT cross-checked against an earlier fixture: the bootstrap-accessibility fragment SHA; aria.tabindex/live/role_status; bootstrap_contract; inline_remaining; fragment_order. (3) MANUALLY-DERIVED CONTRACT - hand-written structural expectations, not captured: d5_contract_patterns. This fixture is NOT regenerated automatically during npm run verify; tests_no_selfgen_golden.js pins its SHA-256 (accidental-change guard) AND re-compares every class-(1) field against its historical fixture (independent-provenance guard). No abs paths/timestamps; no full engine/math body. See the provenance block.

style.convention: inner of <style> (no tags), as captured pre-D in D0.inline_style

fragments.name: BOOTSTRAP_ACCESSIBILITY
fragments.provenance: D5 (new bootstrap region; no earlier phase captured it)

inline_remaining.note: Module-level i18n utils (t/localizeEngineError/colLetter/applyLang, LANG) live OUTSIDE the IIFE and are shared by engine + IIFE; NOT extractable without breaking scope. IIFE-head state (ROWS/COLS/data), the EXAMPLES catalog + metadata, and example helpers are shared init/data consumed by multiple regions; kept inline.

ui_script_no_engine.convention: inline script with the engine region removed (ui pre + ui post), as captured pre-D in D0.ui_script

provenance.note: Per-field provenance in THREE classes. This fixture is ASSEMBLED, never captured wholesale from the composer it validates. Class (1) fields are re-compared against an independent historical fixture by tests_no_selfgen_golden.js; class (2) fields are reviewed D5 captures with no earlier fixture to compare against; class (3) is a manually-derived contract. note, this block, docs/checkpoint-d5-integration.md and docs/testing.md all state the same classification.

class_1_independent_historical_source.composed_total (sha256/chars/bytes), inl: solver-grid-d1.json (D1 phase golden, captured pre-D1 from an independent composed baseline); composed_total additionally cross-checked == pre-D baseline 215539 bytes
class_1_independent_historical_source.external_scripts, css_version: solver-interface-baseline.json (D0) and equivalently the D1 phase golden
class_1_independent_historical_source.aria.aria_attrs, data_i18n_count: solver-detection-d2.json and solver-visualization-d4.json (both pin the same counts independently)

class_2_reviewed_d5_capture.fragments[8] bootstrap-accessibility SHA: captured once during D5 from the composed baseline; the bootstrap region is new in D5 so there is no earlier fixture to compare against; human-reviewed
class_2_reviewed_d5_capture.aria.tabindex, aria.live, aria.role_stat: reviewed D5 captures of the cumulative accessibility counts (D2/D4 only pinned aria_attrs)
class_2_reviewed_d5_capture.bootstrap_contract, inline_remaining, fr: reviewed D5 captures describing the D5 integration surface (bootstrap listeners inventory, still-inline utils, and the exact 9-region order)

class_3_manually_derived_contract.d5_contract_patterns: hand-written structural expectations (literal-substring counts) for the D5 integration mutations; NOT captured from any composed output

provenance.do_not_regenerate: This fixture must NOT be regenerated by the same composer it validates. tests_no_selfgen_golden.js both pins its sha256 (accidental-change guard) AND re-compares every class-(1) field against its historical fixture (independent-provenance guard). Class-(2) captures and the class-(3) contract are guarded only by the pinned sha256; changing them deliberately requires updating PINNED_SHA after review.

d5_contract_patterns_note: Exact literal-substring counts (word=word-boundary) of D5 integration contract shapes in the pre-D composed page (byte-identical baseline). A specific integration mutation trips a precise contract, independent of the fragment hash. Derived from the pre-D composed baseline, not the composer under test.
